# mistershell_configure_policy (Data Source)

Reads a MisterShell configure_policy by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_configure_policy" "example" {
  id = "123"
}

# Alternatively, resolve one exact name.
data "mistershell_configure_policy" "by_name" {
  name = "configure-policy"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID. Specify either ID or an exact name; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.
- `location_ids` (Dynamic) Location ids.
- `position` (Number) Position.
- `resource_types` (Dynamic) Resource types.
- `stack_id` (Number) Stack id.
- `stack_name` (String) Stack name.
- `tag_ids` (Dynamic) Tag ids.
